questions.q: Read 82:13 to 14 with even ghunnah on both «إِنَّ».
questions.a: in-nal-abraara lafee na'eem; wa in-nal-fujjaara lafee jaheem.

questions.q: Pupil PDF: circle every ghunnah in Al-Infitar 82:1 to 19 and write its type. Today's rota group recites 82:1 to 4.
questions.a: نّ in 82:10, 13, 14; مّ in 82:18; idgham with ghunnah in 82:5 and 82:8.

questions.q: Stretch: why is there ghunnah in ikhfa' but not in izhar?
questions.a: In ikhfa' the noon is hidden and its ghunnah remains; in izhar the noon is clear.
A) idgham with ghunnah. Tanween before م merges with ghunnah.

questions.q: Think again: Ghunnah is one of the sifat. Which two letters always carry it, and where does the sound come from?
questions.a: Noon and meem; the sound comes from the nose (al-khayshum).
